# Technical Infrastructure

This folder covers the systemic connections and data mappings that enable information to flow from regional electronic patient journals into national clinical quality registries. It documents how localized configuration gaps, such as missing linkages between specific clinical activities and standardized procedure codes, can directly impair automated data harvesting and compromise the completeness of national databases.

## Pages

- [[technical-infrastructure|Technical Infrastructure]] — Details the systemic data mappings between regional EPJs and national registries, highlighting a specific configuration failure in the NordEPJ system that prevents the harvesting of nutrition plan data for the AKDB.
